# GOG — edition, extras, and preservation update

- Original source: [GOG — edition, extras, and preservation update](https://www.gog.com/en/game/robin_hood)
- Author / publication: GOG / publisher-supplied description
- Language / date: English; preservation changelog 2025-04-25
- Access: Product text and changelog inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

GOG lists a Windows single-player release with offline installers. Included extras are a manual, soundtrack, artwork, avatars, and wallpapers.

The preservation changelog dated 25 April 2025 reports installer fixes, an added DirectX wrapper, and rendering options such as windowed display, V-Sync, gamma correction, integer scaling, and antialiasing. GOG also reports Windows 10/11 compatibility checks and cloud-save support.

The inspected language list includes English, German, Spanish, French, and Polish audio and text. The product description advertises over thirty missions and nine characters across infiltration, robbery, ambush, and castle-attack scenarios.

**Research use:** current edition differences and where owners can obtain the manual and soundtrack. These are GOG's product claims; compatibility was not independently tested. Prices and audience ratings are intentionally omitted because they fluctuate.
